answer.thought: The gardens close in two minutes, and the gatekeeper’s shadow is already falling across the path. I must retreat before the sun is fully gone and the security guards take their posts. My stomach is a hollow drum, but with six rupees I cannot buy even a glass of water, so the only sustenance left is the walk home and the anticipation of sleep. The body complains of its neglect, but the spirit endures the silence of the night.
